# 贡献者公约 | Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## 承诺 | Our Pledge

我们作为成员、贡献者和领导者，承诺使参与本社区的每个人不受骚扰，无论其年龄、体型、可见或不可见的残障、族裔、性特征、性别认同和表达、经验水平、教育、社会经济地位、国籍、个人外貌、种族、宗教或性身份和取向。

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

我们承诺以促进开放、欢迎、多元、包容和健康社区的方式行事。
We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy community.

## 我们的标准 | Our Standards

**正面行为 Examples of behavior that contributes**:

- 展现同理心和善意 · Demonstrating empathy and kindness
- 尊重不同观点与经验 · Being respectful of differing opinions and experiences
- 给予并优雅接受建设性反馈 · Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
- 对自己的错误承担责任并致歉 · Taking responsibility and apologizing to those affected by our mistakes
- 以「言启千行 · 语枢万物」的精神共享知识 · Sharing knowledge in the spirit of "Words inspire thousands of lines of code"

**不可接受行为 Examples of unacceptable behavior**:

- 性化语言或意象、骚扰 · Sexualized language/imagery, harassment
- 人身/政治攻击或侮辱性评论 · Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments
- 公开或私下骚扰 · Public or private harassment
- 未经明确许可发布他人私密信息 · Publishing others' private information without consent
- 其他可合理认为不适合专业环境的行为 · Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate

## 职责 | Enforcement Responsibilities

社区领导者有权利和责任删除、编辑或拒绝与本行为准则不符的评论、提交、代码、Wiki 编辑、Issue 及其他贡献，并将在必要时传达对行为的处理理由。
Community leaders have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned to this Code of Conduct.

## 范围 | Scope

本行为准则适用于所有社区空间，当个人正式代表社区 in public spaces 时同样适用。
This Code of Conduct applies within all community spaces, and also applies when an individual is officially representing the community in public spaces.

## 执行 | Enforcement

辱骂、骚扰或其他不可接受的行为可通过 **admin@0379.email** 向社区领导者报告。所有投诉都将及时且公正地审查和调查。
Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the community leaders at **admin@0379.email**. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

社区领导者有义务尊重报告者的隐私与安全。
Community leaders are obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter.
